newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher,impact of 'tankan' limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher,impact of 'tankan' limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended moderately higher on Wednesday, helped by selective buying of shares with good earnings prospects, brokers said. Mixed results from the "tankan" corporate sentiment survey released in the morning had a limited impact on the market, they added.
The 225-share Nikkei average climbed 167.71 points or 0.94 percent to 18,037.30. Its June futures ended 200 points higher at 18,050.
"Sentiment has improved slightly due to a rally in major steel makers and chip-related shares," said Hisao Suzuki, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
